description: This is a Java interface file 'PaymentService.java' defining the contract for payment-related operations in an insurance management system, including recording premium payments, claim payouts, and listing payments for a customer.

classes.name: PaymentService
classes.description: This interface declares methods for handling payment operations such as recording premium payments, claim payouts, and listing payments for a customer.

methods.name: recordPremiumPayment
methods.description: Records a premium payment made by a customer for a policy, returning the created Payment object.

methods.name: recordClaimPayout
methods.description: Records a claim payout to a customer, returning the created Payment object.

methods.name: listForCustomer
methods.description: Lists all payments associated with a specific customer.
